ei.title: A Black Woman Succeeded in Business for African Americans
ei.subject: 11월_2023 고2 모의고사
ei.lesson: A Black Woman Succeeded in Business for African Americans

fullPassage: Maggie L. Walker achieved national prominence as a businesswoman and community leader. She was among the earliest Black students to attend newly-established public schools for African Americans. After graduating, she worked as a teacher for three years at the Valley School, where she had studied. In the early 1900s, Virginia banks owned by white bankers were unwilling to do business with African American organizations or individuals. The racial discrimination by white bankers drove her to study banking and financial laws. She established a newspaper to promote closer communication between the charitable organization she belonged to and the public. Soon after, she founded the St. Luke Penny Savings Bank, which survived the Great Depression and merged with two other banks. It thrived as the oldest continually African American-operated bank until 2009. Walker achieved successes with the vision to make improvements in the way of life for African Americans.

questions.passage: Maggie L. Walker achieved national (A)[prominence / obscurity] as a businesswoman and community leader. She was among the earliest Black students to attend newly-established public schools for African Americans. After graduating, she worked as a teacher for three years at the Valley School, where she had studied. In the early 1900s, Virginia banks owned by white bankers were (B)[unwilling / eager] to do business with African American organizations or individuals. The racial discrimination by white bankers drove her to study banking and financial laws. She established a newspaper to promote closer communication between the charitable organization she belonged to and the public. Soon after, she founded the St. Luke Penny Savings Bank, which survived the Great Depression and merged with two other banks. It (C)[thrived / declined] as the oldest continually African American-operated bank until 2009. Walker achieved successes with the vision to make improvements in the way of life for African Americans.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
① obscurity(무명) -- unwilling(꺼리는) -- thrived(번성했다): obscurity는 원문 prominence(명성)와 반대
② prominence(명성) -- unwilling(꺼리는) -- thrived(번성했다): 원문 그대로 ←정답
③ prominence(명성) -- eager(열망하는) -- thrived(번성했다): eager는 원문 unwilling(꺼리는)과 반대
④ prominence(명성) -- unwilling(꺼리는) -- declined(쇠퇴했다): declined는 원문 thrived(번성했다)와 반대
det.tip: prominence ↔ obscurity, unwilling ↔ eager, thrived ↔ declined

det.analysis:
① tolerance(관용) -- charitable(자선) -- merged(합병): tolerance는 원문 discrimination(차별)과 반대
② discrimination(차별) -- profitable(수익성 있는) -- merged(합병): profitable은 원문 charitable(자선)과 반대
③ discrimination(차별) -- charitable(자선) -- separated(분리): separated는 원문 merged(합병)와 반대
④ discrimination(차별) -- charitable(자선) -- merged(합병): 원문 그대로 ←정답
